Timestamp.description: Timestamp of the AVL record in microseconds or seconds since Unix epoch.

JourneyPatternID.description: Identifier for the sequence of stops followed by this bus trip pattern.

VehicleJourneyID.description: Unique identifier for the scheduled trip run.

Congestion.description: Binary flag indicating vehicular congestion/delay (0: Free flow, 1: Congested).

Longitude.description: WGS84 Longitude coordinate of the bus.

Latitude.description: WGS84 Latitude coordinate of the bus.

Delay.description: Ground truth delay in seconds relative to scheduled timetable (target variable).

VehicleID.description: Unique identifier of the physical bus unit.

StopID.description: Identifier of the nearest or scheduled bus stop.

AtStop.description: Flag indicating if the bus is currently dwelling at a stop (1: At stop, 0: In transit).

temperature_2m.description: Historical 2-meter air temperature (°C) matched from Open-Meteo.

precipitation.description: Precipitation volume (mm) recorded for the operational hour.

simulated_passenger_occupancy_ratio.description: Simulated passenger capacity load factor (0.0 to 1.0).

injected_disturbance_intensity.description: Controlled disturbance multiplier for drift simulation experiments.
